identity.real_world_identity_notes: The submitted 787B maps to Mazda's 1991 Le Mans-winning Group C sports prototype. Mazda's official specification lists a Mazda–Porsche five-speed plus reverse and a triple-plate clutch; direct driver accounts describe the gearbox as H-pattern and use of the clutch on every upshift and downshift. Independent driving coverage describes the transaxle as fully synchronized. Exact gate layout remains unknown; the exact 1991 cockpit photograph establishes the continuous round, non-display, non-lighted, closed-top wheel.

wheel_rim.notes: The exact 1991 Le Mans-winning-specification cockpit photograph shows a continuous round three-spoke rim, dashboard-mounted instruments, no wheel-integrated display or shift-light strip, and no open-top cutout.
